claim_boundary.verified_scope: record integrity and finite-trial decoded plaintext correctness

statistical_convention.bytes: sum of separate uncompressed library binary serializations
statistical_convention.decode: coefficient recovery plus output-oracle comparison and associated bookkeeping
statistical_convention.end_to_end: per-trial encode + encrypt + eval + decrypt + decode; excludes setup and precomputation
statistical_convention.memory: whole-process peak RSS, not isolated evaluation memory
statistical_convention.setup_and_precomputation: one scalar per process; precomputation includes fixture/oracle construction and interpolation weights
statistical_convention.throughput: min, median and max of 1000 * jobs / per-trial milliseconds
statistical_convention.timings: min, median and max of serialized measured samples; one warmup excluded
